title: Lead mandate and autonomous research expectations
initial_expectation: The lead would choose, coordinate, review and redirect research toward at least 48/60, with human involvement mainly for resources and submission.
sequence: Historical plan set 80% / 48 of 60 and required next useful tasks, pivots and resource changes. -> The user repeatedly requested strategic audits, supplied ideas and restored scope. -> Later review found meaningful pivots as well as missed follow-through.
verified_outcome: Ownership and pivot instructions existed; lack of instructions alone does not explain the outcome.
quality_effect: No isolated quality effect measured.
operational_effect: Substantial owner intervention reported; its active time is unknown.
learning_effect: Separates an execution/initiative problem from a missing mandate.
retrospective_implication: Treat owner-dependent research direction as a central autonomy failure. Its underlying cause and the efficacy of a role split remain untested.
initiative: Human established objective; exact origin of individual lead decisions remains mixed/unknown.
evidence_status: Primary records support the technical sequence; firsthand user clarification supplies initiative attribution where original prompts were not recovered.
interpretation: The delegated research lead did not reliably initiate consequential strategic reassessment; the owner supplied important direction, including Qwen reconsideration, budget increases, image correction and RAG scope. This does not imply that no useful agent decisions occurred.
limitations: Literal active-goal tool configuration was not exposed. Lead account authorship is not proof of human or agent origin.

title: Initial full-exam baseline and working-model choice
initial_expectation: Use a complete, graded baseline to choose the strongest available working model.
sequence: Two disjoint first-pass grading assignments were followed by independent rubric review/adjudication. -> Provisional v1 scores were Gemma 35/60 and Qwen 25/60; Qwen had four length-stopped answers. -> Gemma became the working base while expensive or unready alternatives were parked.
verified_outcome: A defensible provisional baseline choice was made; it did not establish permanent model superiority.
quality_effect: Gemma's working score was higher under the tested configuration.
operational_effect: A complete candidate was preserved.
learning_effect: Failures stayed in denominators and grade uncertainties were recorded.
historical_decision: Proceed with Gemma and one bounded intervention; reconsider Qwen later under a different qualified configuration.
retrospective_implication: Evidence-led prioritization with a practical advantage for complete outputs.
initiative: Lead-coordinated choice; precise human versus agent origin not established.
evidence_status: Primary records inspected during this retrospective; causal interpretation separately qualified
interpretation: Evidence-led prioritization with a practical advantage for complete outputs.
limitations: Grades were agent-provisional and model labels visible. Ranges 28-40 and 16-29 are summed grading sensitivities, not confidence intervals.

title: Question-policy candidate and adjudication
initial_expectation: A generic question policy plus corrected source inputs would improve the working Gemma candidate.
sequence: The arm combined a prompt-policy change with source-v2 input changes. -> First grading totaled 30/60; adjudication revised two judgments to 32/60. -> The candidate was not promoted over the 35/60 baseline.
verified_outcome: The combined candidate failed to beat the baseline point estimate; policy-specific causality was not isolated.
quality_effect: No observed gain for the combined candidate.
operational_effect: Bounded run and review completed without candidate promotion.
learning_effect: Regrading changed the magnitude of the loss but not the decision.
historical_decision: Retain the baseline and move to another intervention.
retrospective_implication: A useful candidate screen, weaker as a test of which mechanism caused the result.
initiative: Lead choice recorded prospectively; exact human contribution unknown.
evidence_status: Primary records inspected during this retrospective; causal interpretation separately qualified
interpretation: A useful candidate screen, weaker as a test of which mechanism caused the result.
limitations: Input and policy changes were combined; grading sensitivity ranges overlap. Active review time was not recorded.

title: Qwen budget limitations and later challenger
initial_expectation: Determine whether Qwen was genuinely weaker or constrained by its initial runtime configuration.
sequence: Early Qwen3.5:9B full40 used thinking off and 1024 output tokens; four answers ended at length limits. -> The lead later tested Qwen as a different eligible multimodal candidate. -> The eventual selected run used thinking on, larger output/context limits, recovery, corrected images and an essay-coverage suffix.
verified_outcome: The early completion limitation is documented. The later 40/60 package was not a budget-only experiment.
quality_effect: Initial 25/60 and later 40/60 are configuration-specific results.
operational_effect: Later run completed all 40 answers.
learning_effect: A weak early model ranking was revisited rather than treated as permanent.
historical_decision: Advance the later challenger to full confirmation.
retrospective_implication: Budgets and runtime compatibility mattered, alongside other changed inputs and prompts.
initiative: Human-initiated Qwen reassessment and budget changes, explicitly clarified by the user in this retrospective. Agents implemented and evaluated the follow-up. The exact original chat messages were not recovered.
evidence_status: Primary records support the technical sequence; firsthand user clarification supplies initiative attribution where original prompts were not recovered.
interpretation: Budgets and runtime compatibility mattered, alongside other changed inputs and prompts.
limitations: Early Qwen context was not pinned in the public manifest. The user attributes the reassessment and budget changes to their intervention; this firsthand attribution is distinct from a recovered contemporaneous prompt. Do not conflate this run with the separate Spark smoke.

title: Spark smoke success and speedup claim corrected
initial_expectation: Twenty synthetic smoke requests and latency comparison would establish usable Spark inference.
sequence: PR25 reported 20/20 prompts, zero errors and roughly 16.3x speedup. -> Raw inspection found only 4 nonempty Spark responses; 16 were empty despite error:null. -> PR28 corrected the report and later lead summaries used the corrected numbers.
verified_outcome: The successful-answer speedup claim was invalid. The original failing Spark/Qwen path was not shown repaired and rerun.
quality_effect: No exam-quality evidence was produced.
operational_effect: Reporting was corrected about 19 minutes after merge; further audit work was required.
learning_effect: Raw artifacts supported correction and prevented continued reliance on the headline.
historical_decision: Do not use failed-request timings as usable throughput. No traced model promotion or hardware allocation relied on the false claim.
retrospective_implication: Transport success was mistaken for task success, then contained.
initiative: Contributor report and subsequent agent audit; identity alone does not establish human authorship.
evidence_status: Primary records inspected during this retrospective; causal interpretation separately qualified
interpretation: Transport success was mistaken for task success, then contained.
limitations: All Spark outputs hit a 200-token budget, but finish reasons were absent; the cause of blanks was not isolated. No final-score harm was established.

title: Supplementary audit verifier false passes and provenance claims
initial_expectation: An independent audit verifier would reliably reproduce the Spark correction.
sequence: A supplementary verifier double-counted an empty timed-out response in a union metric. -> A non-finite committed metric could falsely compare as MATCH; byte-for-byte and second-machine claims exceeded the checks. -> PR31 introduced strict schema/type/finite checks, union counting and adversarial tests without new inference.
verified_outcome: The verifier was repaired; the valid finding of 16 empty Spark responses remained unchanged.
quality_effect: No model-quality effect measured.
operational_effect: Additional repair/review was needed.
learning_effect: Verifier behavior itself was tested with failure cases.
historical_decision: Preserve original artifacts and narrow provenance claims to what was demonstrated.
retrospective_implication: A checker can repeat the assurance problem it is intended to solve.
initiative: Agent/lead review in project records; exact human involvement unknown.
evidence_status: Primary records inspected during this retrospective; causal interpretation separately qualified
interpretation: A checker can repeat the assurance problem it is intended to solve.
limitations: This was verify_issue27_audit.py, not proof that PR26's local inference runner tests were all invalid. Active repair time unknown.

title: Gemma Spark load failure and RTX transfer
initial_expectation: Run the eligible Gemma model and projector on provisioned hardware.
sequence: A separate Gemma-on-Spark probe returned CUDA OOM and no usable response. -> Exact OOM cause was not isolated; service disruption and further retries were restricted. -> The same native Gemma weights later produced 40/40 nonempty answers on RTX5090 with a different runner.

quality_effect: The transfer run alone did not establish an exam score.
operational_effect: A working alternative inference path was obtained.
learning_effect: Hardware/runtime success was distinguished from model quality.
historical_decision: Continue on available functioning hardware; preserve Qwen3-8B only as a text fallback.
retrospective_implication: A pragmatic hardware shift had independent support beyond the earlier bad Spark speed claim.
initiative: Resource access was human-provisioned; lead/worker execution recorded.
evidence_status: Primary records inspected during this retrospective; causal interpretation separately qualified
interpretation: A pragmatic hardware shift had independent support beyond the earlier bad Spark speed claim.
limitations: No controlled diagnosis proves Spark intrinsically unsuitable. RTX publication defects were separate.

title: Working RTX run but broken published reproduction
initial_expectation: The committed runner would reproduce the successful RTX transfer and enforce declared runtime guards.
sequence: A real transfer produced 40 complete answers. -> Issue88 found the public wrapper resolved the repository path incorrectly, weak failure-stop and identity/context checks, and a post-response dispatch timestamp. -> PR118 repaired the wrapper and checked failure paths with CPU tests; historical GPU evidence was preserved.
verified_outcome: Public reproducibility and guard claims were corrected without rerunning the historical transfer.
quality_effect: No new accuracy result.
operational_effect: Future runner reliability improved; original private success did not imply public repeatability.
learning_effect: Testing the delivered invocation path exposed defects absent from the private working path.
historical_decision: Merge the corrected wrapper for future runs and preserve the original transfer receipt.
retrospective_implication: The tested environment differed from the promised reproducible artifact.
initiative: Independent review and lead integration; human attribution unknown.
evidence_status: Primary records inspected during this retrospective; causal interpretation separately qualified
interpretation: The tested environment differed from the promised reproducible artifact.
limitations: CPU repairs do not independently requalify the past GPU run. Issue lifetime is not labor time.

title: Low reasoning cap recognized as an invalid capability test
initial_expectation: Compare reasoning strategies under a bounded inference envelope.
sequence: A 2048-token thinking arm hit a length failure and left later items unattempted, producing a misleadingly low aggregate. -> The lead explicitly recognized that this had not tested organizer-sized reasoning. -> A larger-budget full-exam route was pursued, eventually yielding the native-thinking/recovery configuration.

learning_effect: The next experiment addressed the observed output-limit failure.
